text:
In the homepage Next steps (xtask/src/site.rs, the 'Get the code' item), change the clone step to match README.md: clone into a folder named athena, then cd into it, so './setup.sh' runs from the checkout. Update the assertion in xtask/tests/site_page.rs that checks the clone command. The latest newcomer audience rating flagged the missing cd.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: The homepage install steps clone the repository but never change into the cloned folder before ./setup.sh
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: xtask/src/site.rs, README.md, ./setup.sh, xtask/tests/site_page.rs
